messages:
Priya K: Yikes rain + MUNI alerts this morning. Who's on the 38? Any delays?
Liam H: On the 38 now, stopped near Divis. Driver said theres a stalled truck up ahead. Looks like 15-20m delay.
Jess T: Ugh thats my bus too. If it doesnt move Im walking from Church and 18th.
CommuterBot: Muni alert: Route 38 detour due to stalled vehicle — expect 10-25 minute delays. https://www.sfmta.com/alerts
Omar N: Took the ferry today and it was smooth. Highly recommend if you can swing it, quieter and no traffic jams.
Priya K: Thanks Omar! I might try ferry tomorrow. Anyone else switching modes?
Liam H: Renting a scooter for the short stretch — useful when buses queue up. Wear a helmet though.
Jess T: Will ping if I need a ride share from 16th. Also, remember to bring a second pair of socks if planned rain commute :sweat_drops:
Priya K: Poll: in-office or remote tomorrow? Reply 'office' or 'remote'
Liam H: office (early meeting)
Jess T: remote
Omar N: office (maybe late)
Priya K: remote — ferry day for me. Thanks all. Stay dry! :umbrella:
